text:
morgan: heads up — we want to ship a "cost simulator" in Console to let product teams preview routing/quota changes. thinking a what-if slider for % traffic, routing policy dropdown, and a per-model + per-route cost delta. any blockers?
alejandra: can it model cache warmup? most workloads don't start at steady state. we need warmup curves (10% -> 60% hit over 1h) not just a static hit rate.
sam: i have a tiny sim that extrapolates sampled telemetry to full traffic. it currently reports per-token delta, but it double-counts cache savings for multi-model chains. easy to fix but flagging it.
kevin: attribution question: do we show savings on the tenant invoice or as internal "credits" on the route? finance/legal prefers tenant-level invoice delta. ops wants per-route line items for debugging. need a toggle.
tara: UI idea: three tabs — per-request (example traces + delta), per-route (aggregates), per-tenant (billing-preview). show confidence band from sampling. keep the primary CTA: "Preview invoice impact".
infra-bot: deploy: branch cost-sim/preview pushed to staging — https://stg-console.internal/redwood/cost-sim (deployment id: dp-4421) :rocket:
morgan: thanks. two technical details we must decide now: 1) how to credit cache savings when a cached token is shared across model calls in a chain; 2) how to model reserved capacity fallbacks when routing triggers cheaper model variants.
sam: for (1) proposal: attribute cache savings to the earliest model in the chain that would have produced the token. implement chain-aware key lineage: map token keys -> originating model id, then during simulation dedupe per-request. simple pseudocode:
```
for req in sample:
  seen_keys = set()
  for call in req.chain:
    for key in call.kv_keys:
      if key not in seen_keys and cache_hit(key):
         credit(call.model_id, token_count(key))
         seen_keys.add(key)
```
This avoids double-count.
alejandra: for warmup use an exponential curve parameterized by rho and t_half. default params we can surface and let users tweak. also simulate ongoing churn (new keys per minute).
kevin: for (2) reserved capacity: simulate two modes — "soft spill" where overflow routes to cheaper model (counts as egress + delta latency) and "hard throttle" where requests queue/drop. show both cost and p95 latency impact. must also surface SLA breach probability.
tara: can we add a "canary slider" to simulate rolling a routing policy to X% of traffic? product teams will love seeing immediate projected billing change as they increase % from 0 -> 100. also add a compare mode (current vs candidate).
morgan: agree. rollout plan: default sim runs on sampled telemetry (1% sample), extrapolates, and shows a variance estimate. we need to be explicit in UI about sample assumptions.
sam: one more nuance — quantization/precision changes. if route picks quantized model, token cost changes and sometimes token count changes due to response truncation. simulator should let you toggle model variants (fp16/int8) and show delta.
kevin: for billing UI: add a dropdown "Chargeback policy" with options: "Immediate tenant invoice delta" | "Amortize cache credits across tenants" | "Internal ledger only (no tenant invoice)". show sample invoice lines in the preview and a delta column.
infra-bot: perf note: running a full sim on 1% sample for 30M requests takes ~45s on staging. we should add a background job and notify when ready. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
tara: wireframes next: slider + 3 tabs + compare view + "explainability" popover that expands how credits are attributed. also show top-5 routes driving delta and a link to flamegraph traces.
morgan: action items: Sam — implement chain-aware dedupe and quantized-variant toggle; Alejandra — add warmup/churn model and UI knobs; Kevin — draft chargeback dropdown labels and legal implications; Tara — provide wireframes and microcopy for sample assumptions + variance; I'll open the PR and coordinate staging test.
sam: noted. i'll also add a small toggle to run a "fast estimate" (<5s) vs "full sim" (background job).
alejandra: also add an optional "custom workload" upload (CSV of example routes) for customers who want deterministic sims.
morgan: perfect. i'll follow up with acceptance criteria and example datasets. thanks everyone. (reaction :eyes:)
kevin: tiny ask — include an exportable CSV of per-route deltas so finance can import into their models.
tara: +1. also add a permalink to the simulation config so the team can share specific what-if states.
morgan: will do. closing notes: avoid using the term "prefetch crediting" in docs to reduce confusion with existing prefetch product; use "cache crediting" and "chain-aware attribution". PR coming in a few hours.
kevin: ack.
infra-bot: CI: cost-sim tests passed (32/32). build 4421 -> staging.
morgan: merging when staging looks green.
